items.title_en: Bizarre Beauty Trend Sees Men Trimming Their Eyelashes to Look More Masculine
items.title_zh: 奇怪的美容趋势：男性修剪睫毛以显得更有男子气概
items.summary_en: Long eyelashes have always been a coveted physical feature among women, so much so that we have an entire industry built around the sale and mounting of fake eyelashes. However, long lashes are not as popular among men. Some “alpha types” apparently consider them too feminine and will have them trimmed for a manlier look, despite the serious health risks of such a procedure. Videos of young men having their eyelashes cut or trimmed at barber shops or beauty salons started showing up on TikTok and other social…
items.summary_zh: 长睫毛一直是女性梦寐以求的身体特征，以至于我们有一个围绕假睫毛销售和安装的整个行业。然而，长睫毛在男性中并不那么受欢迎。一些“阿尔法类型”显然认为它们太女性化，因此将它们修剪成更有男子气概的外观，尽管这种手术存在严重的健康风险。年轻男子在理发店或美容院剪睫毛的视频开始流行

items.title_en: Hyrox athlete competes despite diarrhea — using shared equipment and horrifying onlookers
items.title_zh: Hyrox 运动员不顾腹泻仍参加比赛——使用共用设备并让旁观者感到恐惧
items.summary_en: Athlete Joanna Wietrzyk finished in first place at a Hyrox competition in Beijing over the weekend, but she soiled herself in the process, suffering fecal incontinence during the 1 hour, 1 minute and 23 seconds it took her to complete the indoor fitness competition.
items.summary_zh: 周末在北京举行的 Hyrox 比赛中，运动员 Joanna Wietrzyk 获得了第一名，但她在比赛过程中弄脏了自己，在完成室内健身比赛的 1 小时 1 分 23 秒内出现了大便失禁。
items.source: New York Post Weird But True

items.title_en: Rule change submitted to HYROX HQ after athlete refused to quit race despite soiling herself
items.title_zh: 运动员尽管弄脏但仍拒绝退出比赛，规则变更已提交给 HYROX 总部
items.summary_en: The recent HYROX event in China is the first international division of the popular fitness event to ask for change in light of Joanna Wietrzyk's horror 'accident' at the weekend. During the latest Beijing show on Saturday (12 September), Australian athlete Wietrzyk simply brushed off the fact she'd soiled herself and kept competing ; going on to claim victory in the women's solo race with a time of 61 minutes and 23 seconds. Even though athletes aren't allowed to spit, snot or litter on the course, organisers…
items.summary_zh: 最近在中国举行的 HYROX 赛事是这项热门健身赛事的第一个国际赛区，因为 Joanna Wietrzyk 周末发生的恐怖“事故”而要求改变。在周六（9 月 12 日）最新的北京演出中，澳大利亚运动员 Wietrzyk 简单地忽略了自己弄脏了自己的事实，并继续参加比赛；随后以61分23秒的成绩夺得女子个人赛冠军。尽管不允许运动员吐痰、鼻涕

items.title_en: Group of Conspiracy Theorists Damage Traffic Light Sensors They Claim Are Actually Assault Weapons
items.title_zh: 一群阴谋论者损坏了他们声称实际上是攻击武器的交通灯传感器
items.summary_en: Traffic lights have been around for decades, but they’ve been getting a lot of advanced technological upgrades that allow them to detect pedestrians or adjust to the flow of vehicle traffic. It’s the kind of upgrades that most communities would be grateful for, but in Devon County, England, they are apparently treated as a threat and even damaged by concerned citizens. In a video shot by a passer-by in the town of Ilfracombe, a couple of people can be seen climbing a traffic light post and damaging the equipment…
items.summary_zh: 交通灯已经存在了几十年，但它们已经获得了许多先进的技术升级，使它们能够检测行人或适应车辆交通流量。大多数社区都会感激这种升级，但在英格兰德文郡，它们显然被视为威胁，甚至受到有关公民的破坏。在伊尔弗勒科姆镇一名路人拍摄的视频中，可以看到几个人正在爬行交通

items.title_en: HYROX athlete who refused to quit race after soiling herself shares defiant statement in now-deleted post
items.title_zh: 弄脏自己后拒绝退出比赛的 HYROX 运动员在现已删除的帖子中分享了挑衅性的声明
items.summary_en: 35 years after Gary Lineker made faecal history on the football pitch in a World Cup match between England and Ireland, a HYROX champion from Australia has taken on the mantle. Over the weekend, world record holder Joanna Wietrzyk was doing her thing at an indoor endurance event in Beijing when a runny dark liquid began staining her leg. Per news.com.au , video footage and photos captured at the HYROX show reveals how Wietrzyk simply ploughed through the various stages of the course despite clearly pooing herself.…
items.summary_zh: 35 年前，加里·莱因克尔 (Gary Lineker) 在世界杯英格兰队和爱尔兰队的比赛中创造了足球场上的粪便历史，35 年后，来自澳大利亚的 HYROX 冠军接过了这一重任。上周末，世界纪录保持者乔安娜·维特兹克 (Joanna Wietrzyk) 在北京举行的一场室内耐力赛中进行比赛时，一种黑色的液体开始沾染她的腿。据 news.com.au 报道，在 HYROX 展会上拍摄的视频片段和照片揭示了 Wietrzyk 如何简单地经历了该展会的各个阶段。
